lines.text: This butterfly is tasting with its feet.
And what it's tasting for is the clever part.
Butterflies have taste sensors on their feet.
When a mother lands on a leaf, she drums on it with her front legs.
The tapping releases the leaf's juices, so she can taste them.
She's not choosing lunch. She's checking if it's safe food for her caterpillars.
Right plant? She lays her eggs. Wrong plant? She flies away.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
